# Part I: Foundations {.unnumbered .part}

Before the first project, three things: what Quarto does when it renders a document, how to
work with a coding assistant without handing it your judgement, and how to set up a computer
for both. In the workshop, the setup in Chapter 3 and most of the reading in Chapter 2 are done
at home, before the day.
